# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and async rendering** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152 previews Graphite GPU rendering and asynchronous pixel readback on the Skia m152 engine. The preview also expands Vulkan integration options and enables font support on Nano Server. Native-backed views now retain their owners correctly, closing several use-after-free and failure-path leak risks.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 and includes the latest upstream stability fixes from the preceding m151 line. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU bindings introduced** — Adds the next-generation Graphite backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, providing managed access to Skia's newer GPU architecture. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel readback added** — SKImage and SKSurface can request pixel reads without blocking through a backend-neutral API. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Native-backed views retain their owners** — SKRegion span iterators and SKPixmap subsets now keep their source objects alive, preventing use-after-free failures. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Raster image failure cleanup corrected** — SKImage.Create now releases its unmanaged pixel buffer when raster image creation fails. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Managed hot paths allocate and copy less** — SKData.SaveTo avoids a duplicate buffer copy, while encoded-text and runtime-effect uniform lookups reduce recurring managed overhead. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## Platform

- **Nano Server font support enabled** — Uses FreeType so text rendering can resolve fonts on Windows Nano Server. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Silk.NET Vulkan integration packaged** — Adds SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET as a supported bridge for applications using Silk.NET's Vulkan bindings. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp received broader platform validation, including Alpine/musl and Nano Server coverage, alongside project-format modernization.
